rows.rationale: Follows the pinned Simeon form and keeps slave/apostle roles and dense divine title.
rows.before: Simeon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to people who have received a trust equal in honor to ours in the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ:
rows.after: Simeon Peter, a slave and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have received a faith equal in value to ours through the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ:
rows.tsw_comparator: Simeon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have received a trust equal in honor to ours in the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ:
rows.exact_source_record: ⸀Συμεὼν Πέτρος δοῦλος καὶ ἀπόστολος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῖς ἰσότιμον ἡμῖν λαχοῦσιν πίστιν ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν καὶ σωτῆρος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ·

rows.rationale: Keeps divine provision, knowledge and the pinned own-glory reading.
rows.before: His divine power has granted to us everything that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and excellence,
rows.after: His divine power has given us everything needed for life and godliness through knowing the one who called us by his own glory and excellence.
rows.tsw_comparator: His divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and excellence,
rows.exact_source_record: Ὡς πάντα ἡμῖν τῆς θείας δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ τὰ πρὸς ζωὴν καὶ εὐσέβειαν δεδωρημένης διὰ τῆς ἐπιγνώσεως τοῦ καλέσαντος ἡμᾶς ⸂ἰδίᾳ δόξῃ καὶ ἀρετῇ⸃,

rows.rationale: Retains elevated participation, promises and moral decay.
rows.before: by which he has granted to us his precious and very great promises, so that through them you may become sharers in the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world because of desire.
rows.after: Through these he has given us precious and very great promises, so that through them you may become partners in the divine nature, having escaped the corruption in the world caused by desire.
rows.tsw_comparator: by which he has granted to us his precious and very great promises, so that through them you may become sharers in the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world because of desire.

rows.rationale: Keeps generous-supply verb and first links in the virtue chain.

rows.rationale: Preserves divine calling/election alongside active confirmation and emphatic result.

rows.after: Therefore, brothers and sisters, make every effort to confirm your calling and election, for if you practice these things you will never stumble.

rows.after: In this way, entrance into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will be richly supplied to you.
